de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumCostType

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumCostType>
      • EnumCostType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumCostType>

    public enum EnumCostType
extends Enum<EnumCostType>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Cost type (A68).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
